title: The Great Pyramid, 2,000 years ago
caption: In Cleopatra's day, the Great Pyramid still wore its smooth outer casing.
description: The Great Pyramid of Giza did not look like this in Cleopatra's day: it still wore its smooth, polished casing stones. Among the oldest papyri with writing ever found in Egypt (as of 2014) is the logbook of an inspector named Merer, whose crew hauled limestone to build it.
